officialTitle: AOC-CR-296 Petition and Order of Expunction
ownershipDetermination: Prosecutor's instrument. The district attorney completes and files it, so the participant does not complete it and the platform produces no participant fill. It stays in the pathway as guidance.
coBrandingRule: No LegalEase or partner branding may be added to the official form.

ownerDisposition.effect: not generated and not delivered as a participant filing
ownerDisposition.preserved: Guidance for the underlying pathway is unchanged, and any independently supported participant-filed document for that pathway keeps its own route. Retiring this form from the participant lane retires the form, not the pathway.
ownerDisposition.artifactsPendingWithdrawal: Withdrawn. The shared contract is that a family which is not participant-fillable carries no fixture fill, so the fixtures and contact sheet rendered while this family was typed participant_completed are removed rather than kept as unreachable bytes. Their hashes are recorded above so the withdrawal is auditable.

documentOwnerEvidence.statementLine: District-attorney filing. The printed face says so twice: the note under the caption reads "This petition, which is filed by the district attorney, does not require the payment of a filing fee", and the party block is headed "Name And Address Of Defendant", not "Of Petitioner". A participant has no standing to file it, so the platform neither generates nor delivers it as a participant filing.
documentOwnerEvidence.basis: carried forward from the record written when the blank was still readable
